name: Cloud-Native Workload Security
description: Threat model for a cloud-native application using serverless functions, containers, managed databases, and object storage in a multi-tenant cloud environment.

components.name: CDN / WAF
components.description: Content delivery network with web application firewall for edge security

components.name: API Lambda Functions
components.description: Serverless functions (AWS Lambda, Azure Functions) handling API requests

components.name: Containerized Application
components.description: Docker containers running on Kubernetes or managed container service

components.name: Cloud IAM
components.description: Identity and Access Management service managing roles, policies, and service accounts

components.name: Secrets Manager
components.description: Managed secrets service (AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault) storing API keys and credentials

components.name: Managed Database (RDS)
components.description: Managed relational database service with automated backups and encryption

components.name: Object Storage (S3)
components.description: Cloud object storage for user uploads, backups, and static assets

components.name: Message Queue (SQS/EventBridge)
components.description: Managed message queue for async processing and event-driven architecture

components.name: Cloud Monitoring & Logging
components.description: Centralized logging and monitoring service (CloudWatch, Azure Monitor)

components.name: Container Registry
components.description: Private container image registry (ECR, ACR) storing application images

trustBoundaries.name: Cloud Account Boundary
trustBoundaries.description: Separates cloud resources from external internet and other cloud accounts

trustBoundaries.name: VPC/Virtual Network Boundary
trustBoundaries.description: Isolates compute resources from public internet and other VPCs

trustBoundaries.name: Container Trust Boundary
trustBoundaries.description: Isolates containers from host and other containers

threats.title: IAM Credential Theft
threats.description: Attacker steals long-lived IAM access keys hardcoded in Lambda functions or committed to Git repositories, gaining persistent cloud account access.

threats.title: Container Image Supply Chain Attack
threats.description: Compromised base image or malicious package in container introduces backdoor, allowing attacker to compromise all deployed containers.

threats.title: Serverless Function Impersonation
threats.description: Attacker exploits misconfigured Lambda execution role to impersonate the function and access other cloud resources.

threats.title: S3 Bucket Poisoning
threats.description: Attacker uploads malicious files to S3 bucket with overly permissive write access, replacing legitimate files or injecting malware.

threats.title: Container Escape
threats.description: Attacker exploits container runtime vulnerability or misconfiguration to escape container and access host system or other containers.

threats.title: Cloud Audit Log Tampering
threats.description: Attacker with elevated permissions disables CloudTrail/Azure Activity Logs or deletes log entries to hide malicious activity.

threats.title: Insufficient Lambda Execution Logging
threats.description: Lambda functions lack detailed logging of input parameters and business logic decisions, making forensic investigation difficult.

threats.title: Public S3 Bucket Exposure
threats.description: S3 bucket containing sensitive data (customer info, backups) misconfigured with public read access, exposing data to internet.

threats.title: RDS Snapshot Exposure
threats.description: Database snapshots shared publicly or with untrusted AWS accounts, exposing entire database contents.

threats.title: Secrets in Container Images
threats.description: API keys, database passwords, or certificates baked into container images and pushed to registry, exposing secrets to anyone with registry access.

threats.title: Metadata Service Exploitation (SSRF)
threats.description: Attacker exploits SSRF vulnerability to access cloud metadata service (169.254.169.254), stealing IAM credentials and instance metadata.

threats.title: Lambda Throttling Attack
threats.description: Attacker triggers mass Lambda invocations to exhaust concurrent execution limits, causing legitimate requests to be throttled.

threats.title: Cloud Cost Exhaustion (Economic DoS)
threats.description: Attacker triggers expensive operations (Lambda invocations, data transfer, storage operations) to generate massive cloud bills.

threats.title: Overly Permissive IAM Roles
threats.description: Lambda execution roles or container service accounts granted overly broad permissions (e.g., s3:*, iam:*), enabling lateral movement if compromised.

threats.title: IAM Privilege Escalation
threats.description: Attacker with limited IAM permissions exploits misconfigurations (e.g., iam:PassRole, lambda:CreateFunction) to escalate to administrator privileges.

threats.title: Kubernetes RBAC Misconfiguration
threats.description: Overly permissive Kubernetes roles (e.g., cluster-admin binding to default service account) allow container breakout to cluster admin.

mitigations.title: Use IAM Roles Instead of Access Keys
mitigations.description: Eliminate long-lived access keys. Use IAM roles for Lambda, EC2 instance profiles, IRSA for Kubernetes. Rotate temporary credentials automatically.
mitigations.implementation: Assign IAM roles to all compute resources. Delete all access keys. Use AWS STS for temporary credentials.

mitigations.title: Implement Secret Scanning in CI/CD
mitigations.description: Use tools like git-secrets, TruffleHog, or GitHub Secret Scanning to prevent credential commits.
mitigations.implementation: Add pre-commit hooks and CI/CD pipeline checks to block secret commits.

mitigations.title: Container Image Signing and Verification
mitigations.description: Sign container images with Cosign or Docker Content Trust. Configure admission controllers to only allow signed images.
mitigations.implementation: Use Sigstore/Cosign for signing. Deploy Kubernetes admission webhook to verify signatures.

mitigations.title: Automated Container Vulnerability Scanning
mitigations.description: Scan all container images with Trivy, Clair, or cloud-native scanners. Block deployment of images with critical vulnerabilities.
mitigations.implementation: Integrate Trivy in CI/CD. Set policy: block critical CVEs, fail build on high-severity issues.

mitigations.title: S3 Bucket Policies and ACLs
mitigations.description: Disable public access at account level. Use bucket policies with explicit deny for public access. Enable versioning and MFA delete.
mitigations.implementation: Enable S3 Block Public Access. Use CloudFormation guard rules to prevent public buckets.

mitigations.title: Container Security Hardening
mitigations.description: Run containers as non-root. Use read-only root filesystem. Drop unnecessary Linux capabilities. Enable seccomp and AppArmor profiles.
mitigations.implementation: Set runAsNonRoot: true, readOnlyRootFilesystem: true. Drop all capabilities, add only required ones.

mitigations.title: Runtime Container Security
mitigations.description: Deploy runtime security tools (Falco, Sysdig) to detect container escape attempts and suspicious syscalls.
mitigations.implementation: Deploy Falco with custom rules for container escapes. Alert on CAP_SYS_ADMIN usage.

mitigations.title: Immutable Cloud Audit Logs
mitigations.description: Send CloudTrail/Activity Logs to separate security account with write-only permissions. Enable log file validation.
mitigations.implementation: Configure CloudTrail with cross-account delivery. Use S3 Object Lock for immutability.

mitigations.title: Structured Lambda Logging
mitigations.description: Log all Lambda invocations with request ID, input parameters (sanitized), execution duration, and errors in JSON format.
mitigations.implementation: Use structured logging library (winston, pino). Log to CloudWatch Logs with retention.

mitigations.title: S3 Block Public Access
mitigations.description: Enable S3 Block Public Access at account and bucket levels. Use CloudFormation or Terraform to enforce configuration.
mitigations.implementation: Apply account-level block public access. Use AWS Config rules to detect violations.

mitigations.title: RDS Snapshot Encryption and Access Control
mitigations.description: Enable encryption for all RDS snapshots. Never share snapshots publicly. Use KMS keys for encryption.
mitigations.implementation: Set StorageEncrypted: true on RDS. Monitor for public snapshot sharing with CloudWatch Events.

mitigations.title: Secrets Management for Containers
mitigations.description: Use Secrets Manager or Parameter Store for secrets. Mount secrets as environment variables or volumes at runtime, never bake into images.
mitigations.implementation: Use Kubernetes External Secrets Operator or AWS Secrets CSI driver.

mitigations.title: Disable/Restrict Metadata Service Access
mitigations.description: Use IMDSv2 (session-oriented) which requires PUT request. Configure hop limit = 1 to prevent container access to host metadata.
mitigations.implementation: Enforce IMDSv2 only. Set HttpPutResponseHopLimit: 1 on EC2 instances.

mitigations.title: Lambda Reserved Concurrency
mitigations.description: Set reserved concurrency limits on functions to prevent exhaustion. Implement upstream rate limiting.
mitigations.implementation: Set reserved concurrency per function. Use API Gateway throttling.

mitigations.title: Cloud Cost Monitoring and Budgets
mitigations.description: Set up billing alerts and budgets. Monitor for anomalous spending patterns. Implement cost allocation tags.
mitigations.implementation: Create AWS Budgets with 80%, 100%, 150% thresholds. Enable CloudWatch billing alarms.

mitigations.title: Principle of Least Privilege for IAM
mitigations.description: Grant minimum permissions required. Use managed policies with specific resource ARNs. Regularly audit with IAM Access Analyzer.
mitigations.implementation: Generate policies from CloudTrail logs with Access Analyzer. Set resource-level restrictions.

mitigations.title: IAM Permission Boundaries
mitigations.description: Use permission boundaries to set maximum permissions for IAM roles. Prevent privilege escalation paths.
mitigations.implementation: Apply permission boundary to all non-admin roles. Deny iam:PassRole on escalation-prone services.

mitigations.title: Kubernetes RBAC Hardening
mitigations.description: Follow least privilege for K8s roles. Avoid cluster-admin bindings. Use namespace-scoped roles. Audit with kube-bench.
mitigations.implementation: Remove cluster-admin from default service accounts. Use RoleBindings over ClusterRoleBindings.
